Unofficial open-source PC port of OreImouto Re:Port from Sony PSP powered by Godot Engine 4.7.
The game uses the Bring-Your-Own-Game model. All assets (graphics, sound, Live2D models) are extracted directly from legal original UMD disc images.
High-performance native C++ GDExtension decoders (ATRAC3+ via FFmpeg, PMF H.264/OpenH264, Live2D Cubism 2.1).
